info.title: Movete Fácil — QORE Mobile STAGING API
info.description: Contrato de interfaz STAGING. NO LIVE, NO producción, NO pagos reales. La identidad siempre proviene del bearer verificado.
info.x-qore-contract-extension: G68 Passenger-owned delivery read + G69 NOLOGIN one-use SQL delegation. QA ONLY; route NOT MOUNTED

200.description: Client v1 own-trip status STAGING QA only

get.summary: JWT-bound rider trip status with private Client snapshot v1
get.description: Read from verified Passenger JWT + server-owned trip by passengerId. Do not trust ownerId/client role from request. Reveals driver only after persisted assignment. GPS/ETA only on fresh consented verified road evidence; not an operational deployed service. event preserved for legacy G4 QA.

get.description: Driver-only server-filtered offers, independent of push delivery. No caller-supplied actor identity or private passenger information. STAGING QA only.

post.description: JWT-derived ownerId; does not accept price, commission, GPS or route evidence from mobile. Auto passenger rides only; MOTO cargo delivery permitted by separate category and eligibility policy. 201 response is NOT approval of fare for commercial LIVE.

201.description: Durable QA database receipt, no real emergency/operator delivery

post.description: Synthetic disposable PostgreSQL receipt, NOT a live emergency dispatcher; SOS/CRITICAL denied. JWT-derived reporter and independent revocation required; 50 is never a global incident cap.

post.summary: One-time JWT-bound conversion to exclusive Driver role, never LIVE
post.description: User must have single default passenger role, explicit consent, no passenger trip/delivery history; driver remains pending compliance. Service-role RPC only in isolated STAGING.

get.summary: Read the latest reviewed license status for the authenticated Driver
get.description: STAGING QA only. A reviewed license is necessary but NOT sufficient for vehicle eligibility. No identity, path, hash, GPS or document bytes are returned.

200.description: Document-only KYC readiness for this JWT-bound Driver

post.summary: Cancel caller-owned trip using server-side G3 atomic transition
post.description: Passenger JWT only, eventKey=requestKey; body cannot specify amount, refund, cancellation fee, actor or rider. Persistence enforces trip state, owner, idempotency and concurrency. This endpoint never promises a fee or PSP refund; STAGING QA only.

200.description: Idempotent server-persisted cancellation event, not a financial refund

get.summary: Retrieve all passenger history through private, signed keyset pages
get.description: No total-record limit. Fetch pages of up to 50 records using the nextCursor of the previous page in the X-Qore-History-Cursor request header. Cursors are HMAC-SHA256 signed, bound to verified JWT owner, expire after ten minutes of inactivity and advance through the same time-anchored history. Any bad cursor is 400, any failed source is 503; no arbitrary total cap.

200.description: Strictly private sanitized history, first page complete or error

parameters.name: X-Qore-History-Cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from preceding page; never client-generated. Omit only for the first page.

get.summary: A05 QA-only, not deployed: server-authorized admin.kyc.read
get.description: UNMOUNTED QA contract. Admin-exclusive JWT RBAC+verified provider-bound AAL2 MFA required; response fields are strictly whitelisted. Keyset pagination: max 50 per response, UNBOUNDED total records, no global cap. Continuations are signed base64url and session/scope-bound; data is eventually consistent, not an immutable MVCC snapshot. HTTP deployment forbidden without staging authorization.

200.description: Trusted minimal response from server repository (once certified)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque base64url value supplied only as nextCursor by the previous page. No user/tenant scope accepted from query.

post.description: Future QA-only read receipt. Cannot mark a future message or impersonate a participant. G54 delegates private SQL through a one-use CHAT_READ ticket, NOLOGIN role and G42 transactional session lock; never expose owner-only functions.

200.description: Future private QA endpoint; no deployed HTTPS service

get.summary: Future per-assignment private message history, signed cursor and pinned conversation
get.description: Contract-only: provider JWT, G42 session lock and current assignment checked in PostgreSQL. G50 open resolves the ACTIVE conversation. Revisioned HMAC cursor belongs to actor/session/service/conversation. No HTTP route mounted, QA-only.

200.description: Future QA-only private conversation history, no deployed endpoint

post.description: QA-only contract. Verified provider JWT, G42 locked session, exclusive Passenger, current service assignment and idempotent requestKey. Not wired to HTTP.

200.description: Committed message ACK from PostgreSQL, future no mounted server

200.description: Persisted read watermark, internal seq hidden

get.summary: Future isolated Driver inbox (not mounted)
get.description: Exclusive authenticated Driver, G42 session lock and live assignment per conversation. HMAC cursor is actor/session/iat/revision scoped; no raw keyset or passenger identity/phone/PII. No total record cap. QA-only until Auth gateway and real mobile certified.

200.description: Isolated QA Driver inbox response. HTTP is not mounted.

get.summary: QA-only history plus server-issued marker for each incoming Driver message
get.description: Not mounted. Reuses exact G52 page; marker sidecar contains one opaque marker per Driver message authorized in page. Reading the page never marks a message as read. UI must explicitly confirm each visible message, in order.

200.description: Authorized page and ordered visibility sidecar; not a delivery or visibility proof

post.summary: Future explicit and strictly ordered incoming Driver read acknowledgment
post.description: Not mounted. Requires provider-verified exclusive Passenger and a fresh G54 CHAT_READ ticket, plus exact G57 marker and messageId. Rejects later incoming message if any earlier Driver message is still unread. No raw throughSeq, no automatic read on GET.

200.description: Database-confirmed first-unread message only, no SQL sequence exposed

get.summary: Future Driver history plus marker for each incoming Passenger message
get.description: OFF: G56 Driver-only authorized page, one opaque marker per incoming Passenger message, no implicit read on history fetch. G57B database requires earliest unread first.

200.description: QA-only Driver G56 page and G57B markers

post.summary: Future Driver confirmation of one actually visible, earliest unread Passenger message
post.description: OFF: independently authenticated exclusive Driver; G42 session and assignment rechecked in SQL, marker from G56 page, no caller-supplied seq, and no skip of earlier Passenger messages.

200.description: Persisted and ordered Driver read ACK

get.summary: Future Passenger-only delivery custody status (G68/G69, not mounted)
get.description: Requires independently verified Passenger JWT, G42 held session lock, delivery AND sender SQL filters, G67 verified proof for terminal states. G69 delegates a single-use opaque owner-attested SQL read to NOLOGIN EXECUTE-only role in isolated PostgreSQL16 CI. No public proof mint, no real IdP, HTTPS provider, storage or deployed route.

200.description: QA-only sender-owned SQL custody snapshot. Requires JWT Passenger and G42 session scope; not mounted publicly.

post.summary: Resolve AUTO route with independently verified provider and coverage
post.description: Verified Passenger JWT and server-only routing provider; returns only echoed intent plus verified route UUID, cannot be used without a certified routing provider. No GPS leak or commercial fare.

200.description: Owner-only synthetic receipt; persistent STAGING or commercial operation is not certified

200.description: Owner-only synthetic receipt; persistent STAGING or commercial operation is not certified

post.summary: Confirm consented AUTO booking in disposable QA
post.description: Explicit accepted=true required. SQL durable on disposable QA DB only. Returns identical tripId to read recovery. Private side-effect dispatch failure cannot undo a previously committed booking.

201.description: Owner-only synthetic receipt; persistent STAGING or commercial operation is not certified

get.summary: Reconcile own committed AUTO booking
get.description: Authenticated Passenger subject, never a caller-supplied owner; 404 for absent or foreign booking. GET never dispatches again. 409 for invalid/untrusted receipt. No HTTPS/PG remote certified.

parameters.name: bookingKey
parameters.description: Booking idempotency UUID originally returned in requestKey (never a tripId, Driver ID or owner from client)

200.description: Owner-only synthetic receipt; persistent STAGING or commercial operation is not certified

get.summary: Read private G90/G91 AUTO dispatch search without Driver identity
get.description: Owner-only G85 queue with G91 pre-reconciliation G4 offer; offering is not acceptance. 404 means missing/foreign; 409 means structurally contradictory receipt; 503 means SQL adapter unavailable. Attempts 0–12. No Driver ID, offer ID, GPS or ETA until verified assignment. B R67 contract.

parameters.name: bookingKey
parameters.description: Booking idempotency UUID originally returned in requestKey (never a tripId, Driver ID or owner from client)

200.description: Owner-only synthetic receipt; persistent STAGING or commercial operation is not certified

post.summary: Persist and return authorized AUTO campaign subsidy before booking
post.description: Passenger JWT identity; POST with no body. Return 10% subsidy funded from 15% original fare nominal commission only when Owner campaign authorized, legal route/quote still fresh; request cannot set rates or amounts. Not mounted on remote HTTPS. Existing G73 15-field quote does NOT include this discount, so Cliente B must explicitly read this independent receipt before allowing consent. Server G93 SQL trigger rejects active-campaign bookings lacking preview.

200.description: Idempotent server-stored subsidy quotation in PYG (QA only)

Success.description: Respuesta autenticada STAGING; los flags live permanecen false.

RiderStatusV1.description: JWT-derived own-trip Client B snapshot; QA STAGING only. The nested event is backward compatibility, not GPS proof.

ServerPricedQuoteV1.description: Client-safe response derived only from JWT passenger + authoritative G7 quote and verified route evidence; STAGING only

ServerPricedQuoteReceipt.description: Legacy G7 server-owned quote. Validate on server, do not let Cliente set price or commission.

RiderOwnHistoryV1.description: All historic owned trips, deliveries and merchant orders, with no total record ceiling. Each page carries up to 50 entries and an opaque JWT-owner-bound HMAC keyset cursor; repeat until nextCursor=null. STAGING QA only.

nextCursor.description: Opaque signed continuation, returned until all owned historical rows have been retrieved; no global maximum.

body.description: No phones, emails, URLs, bidi or controls; server revalidates
No phone/email/URL/HTML; validated by SQL and Node

SenderOwnedDeliveryCustodyG68.description: Server-verified Passenger-owned delivery status. Exactly 11 fields, no courier identity, proofRef, location, phone or media. Terminal proofVerified originates from G67 atomic SQL custody evidence; no LIVE.

G90PrivateDispatchReceipt.description: All fields are server-verified. OFFER_PENDING iff offerPendingAcceptance=true. While tripState=searching, dispatchState cannot be CLOSED; once not searching dispatchState=CLOSED. No driverId, offerId, GPS, ETA, device or contact data.

G93AutoSubsidyPreview.description: Stored Server-only G93 AUTO_RIDE campaign preview before consent; NOT a commercial price, insurance permission, PSP payment or native deployment. MOTO_RIDE needs distinct legally verified route and fare. All financial fields must be verified and reconciled on server.
